capabilities.title: Manual scoring and Mark point
capabilities.method: Player taps point winners, end types and bookmarks; the score is folded from the log.

capabilities.title: Fast Point Review
capabilities.method: Player confirms or corrects each point; corrections supersede, never overwrite.

capabilities.title: Changeover checkpoint auto-fill
capabilities.method: Bounded enumeration of point winners consistent with as-called game scores and legal game lengths.
capabilities.notes: Not yet in spec/reference; needs its own fixtures before either platform ships it.

capabilities.title: Racket-ball hit detection (audio)
capabilities.method: Spectral-flux onsets on the audio track with travel-time correction (vDSP / Accelerate).

gate.minimumData: Synthetic sample video benchmark plus >= 10 real sessions at >= 3 venues

capabilities.notes: D10: suggestions always start as Needs review. Unavailable when the microphone is off (D5).

capabilities.title: Rally segmentation
capabilities.method: Rallies = hits with gaps < ~3 s; point gaps > ~5 s; motion corroboration.

capabilities.title: Court calibration (4 taps)
capabilities.method: Player taps four singles-court corners; homography from ITF dimensions.

capabilities.title: Camera-moved detection
capabilities.method: Homographic registration of frames against the calibration frame.

capabilities.title: Line-snap corner suggestion
capabilities.method: Contour and line detection around a corner tap at full resolution suggests a snapped corner; the user accepts or ignores it, and manual taps stay the source of truth.

metrics.name: snapped corners within 2 px of hand labels

capabilities.notes: Pre-seeded by T02. Stays disabled, with no UI, unless its benchmark record passes (T35).

capabilities.title: 2D pose overlay (Stroke Lab)
capabilities.method: Apple Vision / ML Kit 2D body pose on demand on selected frames; never scored.

capabilities.title: Serve speed (manual-assisted)
capabilities.method: Player marks contact and bounce frames and taps the bounce on the calibrated court; average speed = distance / time from an assumed contact point above the server's baseline position.

capabilities.title: Shot placement (manual taps)
capabilities.method: Player taps bounces on the court diagram or the calibrated frame.

capabilities.title: Face blur in exports
capabilities.method: On-device face rectangles (Apple Vision / ML Kit) on exported frames; every detected face is blurred. Faces the camera can't see clearly may not be blurred.
capabilities.notes: Pre-seeded by T02 at disabled; T39 moves it to estimated and its page says 'Not benchmarked'. Ungated: no benchmark record is required for estimated.

capabilities.title: Automatic stroke classification
capabilities.method: Out of v1 (backlog Later).

capabilities.title: Ball tracking
capabilities.method: Out of v1 (backlog Later).

capabilities.title: Automatic bounce maps
capabilities.method: Out of v1 (backlog Later).

capabilities.title: Automatic point winners
capabilities.method: Out of v1 (backlog Later). The log format already separates detected from reviewed outcomes.

capabilities.title: Line calls
capabilities.method: Never: far-baseline resolution is 0.2-0.4 m per pixel against 5 cm lines.

capabilities.title: Spin RPM
capabilities.method: Never from a single phone camera.

capabilities.title: 3D biomechanics
capabilities.method: Never from a single phone camera.

capabilities.title: String-bed pitch check
capabilities.method: Relative acoustic estimate; P2 candidate pending bench gate and patent review.
